title: Lifting points and structural stalk germs through affine localization
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings, S an R-algebra localizing a submonoid M. Let c:Y->X, f:Y->Spec S and g:X->Spec R form a cartesian square with Spec(algebraMap R S). If x is a point of X and M is disjoint from the prime ideal of g(x), there is x0 in Y with c(x0)=x and a ring equivalence e:O_{Y,x0}->O_{X,x}. For every r in R it sends the f-structural germ of algebraMap(r) to the g-structural germ of r.

proof.text: Choose an affine neighborhood Spec D of x. Its base change is Spec of D localized at the image of M. The ideal of x avoids these denominators because its contraction to R is g(x). Extend it using localization prime correspondence. Transport this point through the affine-open inclusion and the cartesian comparison to obtain x0 with c(x0)=x.

Localizing D first at the image of M and then at the extended prime gives D localized at the original prime, by transitivity of localization. Thus the projection stalk map is an isomorphism. Invert it and transport across c(x0)=x to define e. Naturality of composite stalk maps and stalkMap_toStalk for Spec(algebraMap R S) give the asserted identity for all r.

theorem exists_lift_stalkEquiv_of_isLocalization
    (R S : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : Y ⟶ X) (f : Y ⟶ Spec S) (g : X ⟶ Spec R)
    (hsq : IsPullback c f g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))))
    (x : X) (hx : Disjoint (M : Set R) ((g x).asIdeal : Set R)) :
    ∃ x0 : Y, c x0 = x ∧
      ∃ e : Y.presheaf.stalk x0 ≃+* X.presheaf.stalk x,
        ∀ r : R,
          e ((f.stalkMap x0).hom
            (StructureSheaf.toStalk S (f x0) (algebraMap R S r))) =
              (g.stalkMap x).hom (StructureSheaf.toStalk R (g x) r)
